name: Torban Buck's blue-bladed lightsaber
description: Torban Buck's blue-bladed lightsaber, also known as Torban's lightsaber was a curved-hilt lightsaber owned by Jedi Master Torban Buck during the High Republic Era. Possessing a wooden hilt and blue blade, Buck was relatively proficient in the lightsaber's use, but preferred not to fight since he was a Jedi healer.
